rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

grep for 'opening lecture|earlier lecture|last module' -> 0; 'You drew the box' names the artefact (Product Box game), not a file by position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no demo/guess beat in either slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 carries 3 paragraphs with a self-carrying claim (write the customer's face before building); chunk 2 carries the reference claim; closest to thin: chunk 2 last line 'Keep the box current.' but follows 4 paragraphs of content.

chunk 1 header 'Would a customer pick up the box?' answered by 'If you cannot write that face, you are not yet sure what you are building for'; chunk 2 header 'The product box keeps the agents on course' matches body 'Work that serves nothing on the box is off course'.
grep 'Not .*\. Not ' -> 0; no triples; no superlatives; closest: 'Keep the box current. A stale reference steers just as firmly.' is a pair, not anaphora.

rules_evaluated.evidence: git log shows no header-only change; header 'The product box keeps the agents on course' is answered by every paragraph (drift, reference, point agents, keep current).
